_about: The first-month journey: planned moments, at most one per user per Lagos day, counted from the account's created date. Defaults live here; the admin can override any field per moment id, switch moments off, change the day, or add a moment, without a release (stored in the database, merged over this file). trigger: day (day..dayTo plus graceDays after), payday, allowance, month_end, month_after. A moment is never served twice to a person. skipIf: the job is already done. requires: facts that must hold. push.copyKey reuses a line from nudge-copy.json; push.text is new copy for moments that had none. No emoji and no em dashes anywhere in this file.
